turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a big storm on my commute day tomorrow and I'm stuck on how to get to work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My usual bus takes forty minutes, but in bad weather it's packed and always late.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could drive, which would be warm and dry, but parking near the office costs a fortune.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could ask my boss if I can work from home, which she allows, though she doesn't love it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you've got meetings in person, drive and accept the parking fee as a one off. Otherwise just ask your boss to work from home tomorrow, most managers understand on a stormy day.
